observations: body L10: «195-121» stands for 105-121: the pages 53-63 and 105-121 of Cosmos make the 28 pages 12-39 of the offprint; the dash is short, like a hyphen; kept as printed.
body L13: «posita» is printed for positam (with insulam); kept as printed.
body L19: a speck stands before «ǵāl»; it is not a sign.
body L21: the smooth breathing of «Ὀζήνη» stands before the capital, as usual.
body L37: the opening bracket before «Superficies» is printed heavy, its upper arm short.
notes_left L2-L3: «iudiciis» and «rorum» at the head of the lines are printed heavy, like bold italic; they are set in the italic of the title.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
